a.lede: The US government filed an application to support the company’s legal challenge against a fine issued under the bloc’s Digital Services Act, which Trump has described as “overseas extortion.”
a.title: The Trump Administration Is Trying to Get Musk and X Out of a $137 Million EU Fine

b.lede: Washington says Brussels overreached when it fined X €120 million under the DSA.
b.title: Trump administration takes Musk’s side in fight over EU tech rules
